integrity: Original construction and properties of generic flexibility and non-flexibility are attributed to Nikitina; topological Thom and suspension splitting lemmas are standard. The new contribution is the explicit geometric decomposition and its full homotopy consequence, with a self-review only.
scientific_limitations: Classical complex topology only for the indicated affine quotient family. No algebraic A1-homotopy classification or analogous theorem for arbitrary generically flexible varieties; independent review not performed. Equivalent unindexed work remains possible.
title: Wedge-of-spheres homotopy type of smooth generically flexible affine quotients
